title: Move everything from axHub web into the console
summary: Every axHub web page, option and action becomes a console screen under one Hub view group (hub-console@1), with the same reach by deep link, REST, MCP, CLI and voice; axHub stays backend + MCP only and its web UI is retired. Parked copy of build move-everything-axhub-web-console: the build runs the steps; this plan is the whole migration in one place.
goal: The Dev Console is the only hub UI. Approvals, log, passes/veto, users, account, apps/connectors, services, handoff, auth admin and every hub setting live in the console and work from the phone through Phone Connect.
why: Brett, Nov 17 2026: "I really need to get this axHub and AmberX over the console. I really need that done. With the phone app."

steps.text: Inventory every axHub web page, option and setting (approvals, approval log, passes, veto/countdown, users, account, apps/connectors, services, handoff, auth admin, each settings page) and the axHub REST/MCP endpoint behind each one; write the parity map as a hub-console@1 spec draft and save the whole migration as a parked Plan Studio plan

Define the hub-console@1 contract: one console address per hub screen (view:hub/…), the state shape each screen reads, the action list per screen with personOnly flags (approve/deny/shelve/grant pass stay person-only), and how the console reads them through the hub (proxy, own session, never the console token for decisions); add the schema and a fixture
Write the hub-console@1 validator and route table (framework/core/hub-console.mjs) with a spec check that holds it to the fixture, and record the deferred Android twin in PORTING.md

Design the migration of axHub web's saved UI settings (per-user page prefs, approval view options, connector display options) into console settings keys, and write the one-shot migration script with a dry-run mode
Scaffold the hub-admin console plugin: plugin.json (builtWith, lifecycle dataDir, settings tab under Plugins), install.mjs and uninstall.mjs, and an empty Hub view group registered on the console nav
Server side of the plugin: a FastAPI router that proxies the hub-console@1 reads to axHub with retries and a clear unavailable state, plus its unit tests

Approvals screen: live list of held/confirm calls with countdown, title-first reason, collapsible code, and Approve / Deny / Shelve through the approvals-banner relay (Brett's own hub session, personOnly), on framework controls and the tab-group asset

Approvals API part: deep link view:hub/tab:approvals, state read REST + MCP tool hub_approvals_list, CLI `axf hub approvals`, voice action hub.approvals; decide actions registered personOnly so no session can run them
Approval log screen: searchable history of decided/expired/denied calls with filters (service, tool, who, outcome) as a DataGrid
Approval log API: deep link, REST + MCP hub_approval_log, CLI `axf hub approval-log`, voice hub.approvalLog
Passes and veto settings screen: active passes with revoke, grant pass form (service, tools/scope, minutes), veto countdown length and No-wait status shown read-only where owner-only
Passes/veto API: deep link, REST + MCP hub_passes_list / hub_pass_revoke / hub_pass_request (grant stays Brett's click), CLI `axf hub passes`, voice hub.passes; countdown setting through control@1
Users screen: list, invite, roles, disable, with destructive actions behind confirm
Users API: deep link, REST + MCP hub_users_*, CLI `axf hub users`, voice hub.users; role changes and disable need confirm
Account screen: profile, sessions/devices with sign-out, linked phone, notification prefs
Account API: deep link, REST + MCP hub_account_*, CLI `axf hub account`, voice hub.account
Apps/connectors screen: connected services with status, policies per tool (allow/veto/confirm), add/reconnect/remove connector, token health shown as systems-check items
Services detail screen: one service's tools, schemas, policy editor and recent calls

Connectors/services API: deep links (view:hub/tab:connectors, row:<service>), REST + MCP hub_services_list / hub_service_get / hub_policy_set / hub_connector_remove (confirm), CLI `axf hub services`, voice hub.services; register a health@1 check for dead connector keys
Handoff screen: open handoffs between devices/sessions, send, accept, clear
Handoff API: deep link, REST + MCP hub_handoff_*, CLI `axf hub handoff`, voice hub.handoff
Auth admin screen: OAuth clients, API tokens (create shows once, revoke with confirm), sign-in methods; no secret ever stored in the console
Auth admin API: deep link, REST + MCP hub_auth_*, CLI `axf hub auth`, voice hub.auth; token create/revoke personOnly or confirm per the contract

Hub settings: one Settings → Plugins → Hub sub-tab with the level toolbar, every former axHub web setting as a registered setting; run the settings migration from step 4 against a copy and wire it into install.mjs

Console-control registration: every hub screen, tab, row and action gets its control address (data-axf-target), toolbars role=toolbar + settings ids, tab rows through TabGroup; make check-console-control, check-toolbars, check-chrome-assets, check-theme and check-controls pass

Phone Connect tie-in: hub approval and veto notices open the console's Approvals screen through Phone Connect deep links instead of the AmberX app; note the overlap with builds phone-connect and remove-amberx-app-code-once-phone on those builds

Parity check: a script that walks the hub-console@1 route table and fails when any axHub web page/action has no console screen, deep link, REST route, MCP tool, CLI command or voice action; add it to CI

Retire the axHub web UI from this repo's side: apps/axhub-web marked retired in its manifest, axhub.amberxai.com UI paths redirect to the console's Hub screens (deploy config), shared-assets list updated; open the matching axHub-repo change as a follow-up item (server stays backend/MCP only)
Docs and help: plugin README, help entries, glossary descriptions, decision line in memory/decisions.md, rule line that the console is the only hub UI
UI Review: desktop + phone shots of each hub screen with 3 options per screen as assets, submitted with --choices

Run all checks (hub-console spec check, plugin tests, parity, theme/controls/toolbars/console-control, lifecycle --after-uninstall, console typecheck + build), write _claude/builds/reports/move-everything-axhub-web-console.md with how each screen is reached by deep link/REST/MCP/CLI/voice, update the THREADS row, push the branch and open the PR

requirements.text: Decisions (approve / deny / shelve / grant pass / delete user / create token) are Brett's own tap through the approvals-banner relay: personOnly, never the console token.
Every screen: deep link (view:hub/tab:hub.tabs=…), state read over REST + MCP, every non-person action over REST, MCP, CLI and voice, all four the same.
UI on framework controls and asset tokens only; TabGroup for the tab row; check-theme, check-controls, check-toolbars, check-chrome-assets and check-console-control pass.

acceptance.text: The parity script walks the hub-console@1 route table and finds no axHub web page or action without a console screen, deep link, REST route, MCP tool, CLI command and voice action
apps/axhub-web is marked retired; axhub.amberxai.com UI paths redirect to the console Hub screens
Phone Connect deep links open the console Approvals screen from hub notices

decisions.text: Hub facts the hub does not expose yet (connector add / remove, device handoff accept / clear, OAuth client and API token admin) show a clear "this hub has not got it yet" state and answer hub_missing on the API; the axHub-repo routes are a follow-up item (step 28). See framework/spec/HUB-CONSOLE.md.

risks.text: The console token must never decide: a route-table mistake could let a session approve its own call.
risks.mitigation: Decide actions are personOnly in console-control@1 and the relay refuses the console token; the spec check and the parity script assert both.

outOfScope.text: New Android or Kotlin work: the twin is recorded as a deferred gap in PORTING.md.

links.label: Remove the AmberX app code once Phone Connect is paired

body:
# Move everything from axHub web into the console

See `framework/spec/HUB-CONSOLE.md` for the page-by-page inventory (hub endpoint, reads, actions, options) and the console address each page lands on.

Parked: the build `move-everything-axhub-web-console` runs these steps; this plan is the parked whole so later sessions see the migration in one place.
